entities.summary: Li Huanzhi, originally Li Zhaocai, also known as Li Zhonghuan, was a Chinese classical composer of the 20th century. Born in Hong Kong, his ancestors came from Jinjiang City, Quanzhou, Fujian, and his mother was Taiwanese.
